method: Rebuilt the 180 EC route from the current ACTA regulations and exact annual group codes. Checked the clinical progression, placement prerequisites and three assessment parts, then reread current workbook anatomy, lab, biomedical, epidemiology and health psychology evidence before checking both schedules and all displayed fields.
findings: OER Article 11.3 and TB_TANDHK agree on 10, 12 and 11 positive-credit units and 60 EC per year. The zero-credit Dutch test is integrated into Introduction. Professional conduct is already included. No standard open elective block. The individual free degree and honours are separate and are excluded.

Article 9.1 sets early oral biology and caries, direct restorations, skills 1A and New Patient practical attendance in 1B before year-two prevention and skills 2A. Skills 2B also requires passed 1B and attendance at 2A. Year-three prevention and treatment follows passed year-two prevention, care planning, periodontitis, prevention line and both skills lines. The 14 EC placement requires passed year-one research methods and year-two research preparation.

The exact 2026–2027 T_B3WSTAGE entry confirms supervised dental or related biomedical research or extended literature study, usually with another student, with a thesis and oral defence. Execution, thesis and presentation are separately passed. The assessment paragraph uses an alternate block label, while the exact code, name, credits and prerequisites agree with the OER.

The UCR plans contain real biomedical, behavioural and public-health science and pass current feasibility. Functional Anatomy concerns general body systems and imaging, and Life Science Laboratory teaches relevant culture and molecular methods. Neither provides dental skills, treatment or the oral-disease sequence. The resulting no-match is substantive.
